title: Bespoke Portals vs. ERP Desktop Clutter: Multi-Branch Ordering for GCC Retail
content:
A retail and restaurant chain across Riyadh and Dubai operating 45 branches faced an adoption crisis:

Branch supervisors were supposed to submit daily replenishment orders directly into Odoo.

Instead:
- They forgot passwords.
- They got confused by complex ERP accounting and purchase requisition tabs.
- They resorted back to sending chaotic voice notes on WhatsApp to the central commissary.

Why? Because giving a retail store manager full access to enterprise ERP desktop forms is like giving someone a airplane cockpit to drive to the grocery store.

Scando built a bespoke, lightweight Progressive Web App (PWA) layer connected to Odoo's backend:
→ Simple visual menu: Branch managers tap items, select quantities, and click «Submit Order».
→ Strict Order Windows: Cutoff times (e.g. 4:00 PM) automatically enforced by API rules.
→ Live Delivery Tracking: Branch receives push notifications when the distribution center dispatches the truck.
→ Instant Back-End Processing: The order lands immediately in central Odoo as an automated delivery picking slip without human data entry.

Result:
- 100% branch compliance within 48 hours.
- Zero WhatsApp ordering chaos.
- Central warehouse cut requisition processing time from 4 hours to 15 minutes.

Use Odoo as your enterprise database engine. Build consumer-grade interfaces for your frontline operators.

Let's discuss how tailored app layers can elevate your multi-branch operations in KSA and the UAE.
notes: Targeted at GCC operations directors in retail, distribution, and hospitality. Solves the branch-to-headquarters ordering bottleneck.
